assets.launcher-underground.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D side-view platform game sprite animation sheet. Paint an ecological spring-launch mushroom / wind seedpod rooted on a compact stone moss base. Detailed hand-painted dark fairytale game art with fine dark ink contours, richly textured readable shapes, like Hollow Knight botanical environments. EXACTLY EIGHT poses, four columns two rows, generous transparent gutters. Every cell has exactly the SAME organism and SAME base width / position; all bases aligned within each row, each cell independently transparent. Read left to right: 1 REST round springy domed cap with upward arrow-shaped gills, 2 squash preparing spring, 3 deepest squash, 4 upward thrust tall open cap with small upward air streaks, 5 peak stretched launch with a few spores, 6 recoil down, 7 settle, 8 return to original rest. The base NEVER moves. NO labels, NO text, NO background, NO ground panel, NO grid lines, NO shadows outside base. Entire silhouettes fit each cell, no overlap. 1536x1024 landscape canvas, 4x2 cells, subject about 240px wide and 260px tall except compressed/tall poses. Underground biome: warm ochre brown porous cap, pale cream gills, compact earth stone base, little warm gold spores. Cap is low and springy, NOT a tall generic mushroom. Readable upward spring motif.
assets.edge-decor-underground.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent foreground edge decorations for a 2D side-view platform game. Detailed hand-painted dark fairytale terrain embellishments with fine dark ink contours, richly textured readable shapes matching Hollow Knight botanical environments. EXACTLY SIX isolated separate sprites in three columns two rows with generous transparent gutters. 1536x1024 landscape. First row: (1) tiny scattered pebble cluster and a few sprouts, low silhouette; (2) medium irregular tuft attached along flat ground with one small rock; (3) large asymmetrical grass and twisted-root clump with subtle leaf silhouettes, fuller but leaves leave player readable. Second row: (4) hanging thin roots and dangling grass attached to the UNDERSIDE of flat horizontal ground, attachment line at top; (5) medium textured outgrowth attached to RIGHT-facing vertical stone wall, attachment line at left with outward pieces facing right; (6) larger curled roots and crystals attached to LEFT-facing vertical wall, attachment line at right with outward pieces facing left. Each standalone sprite has a clean short attachment line, NO solid square tiles, NO platforms, NO labels, NO text, NO white background, NO opaque backdrop, no UI. True transparent alpha. Underground biome: warm ochre earth, slate rocks, amber tiny crystals, wiry dry roots and thin fungi. Keep leaf and grass amounts sparse, earthy brown and cream palette.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D side-view long one-way platform sprite atlas.
Reference image: existing underground terrain atlas shown, use ONLY its row-three thin suspended root/rock platform paint style and the grounded detailed hand-painted fine dark outlines. Draw NEW native long four-cell platforms, do not stretch/copy old art.
Exactly THREE separate long horizontal shelves stacked vertically, one per row on 1536x1024 transparent canvas. Each shelf about 1300px wide and 180px tall, with 70px padding left/right and generous 100px CLEAR transparent gutters betweenrows. Shelf body is continuous solid rock and intertwinedroots below a straight horizontal walkable top, no gaps in platform body across its length. Tiny grass and stone edge decorations may project upward sparingly, dangling roots below body. No large shrubs. Every shelf same length, four imaginary96pxgamecells: a long continuous shape with different stones not repetitive.
TOP shelf: sky biome cool blue-gray stones, soft pale blue grasses, silver roots.
MIDDLE shelf: tree trunk biome dark brown woody roots, rough bark stones and lush green moss.
BOTTOM shelf: underground biome warm ochre earth and amber brown rocks, twisted roots and tiny cream mushrooms.
No square blocks, no labels, no text, no frame borders, no background or colored fog, genuine transparent alpha. All shelves fully contained with clear margins.
